target: Load CSV data while preserving leading zeros in an identifier column.
requirements: Write a Python function named load_players(csv_text).
Accept CSV content as a string, not a file path.
Preserve player_id values as the strings 001 and 002.
checks: The returned DataFrame has two rows.
fps values equal [120, 85] and have a numeric dtype.
scope_note: This exercise does not resolve the GitHub issue or establish readiness to modify pandas internals.
